description: A minimal 2-Worker TypeScript service: Worker 1 creates utility functions, Worker 2 imports them and exposes a service entry point.

workers.description: Creates utility functions: formatDate and makeRunLabel.
workers.taskDescription: Implement formatDate(date: Date): string and makeRunLabel(runId: string): string in src/utils.ts. Export both as named exports.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 1 creates provider utilities: formatDate and makeRunLabel with correct signatures.

workers.description: Imports formatDate and makeRunLabel from Worker 1, exposes runService as the main entry point.
workers.taskDescription: Implement runService(runId: string): string in src/service.ts. Import formatDate and makeRunLabel from worker-1. Export runService as named export.
workers.acceptanceDescription: Worker 2 imports provider utilities and exports runService function that composes formatDate and makeRunLabel.

acceptance.description: Worker 1 creates provider utilities: formatDate and makeRunLabel with correct signatures.
Worker 2 imports provider utilities and exports runService function that composes formatDate and makeRunLabel.
Contract, honesty, drift, isolation, integration, token proof, and hash chain gates must pass in execution phase.
